title: you get what you paid for!
text: you get what you paid for!. this is a tall end table that requires assemblyth, so if you're not handy get something else. it was a bit difficult for me to figure out how to put it together. the directions are included and the color is great. the material it is made from is a bit flimsy and once I put it together it was slightly wobbly. again the product looks great, does what it's suppose to do but is cheaply made. you get what you paid for!
